blurbs.Fantasy weapons: Swords, axes, maces, polearms, bows and shields of medieval and fantasy packs: knights, Vikings, samurai, orcs, dwarves, demons and cavemen.
blurbs.Modern weapons: Firearms from flintlock-era revolvers to sniper rifles, the FPS packs' guns (skeletal, with their own shot and reload clips), and knives, clubs and grenades.
blurbs.Futuristic weapons: Sci-fi guns, arm cannons, energy blades and shields of the sci-fi, alien and dystopian packs.
blurbs.Non-weapon items: Food and drink, medicine, tools and devices, treasure, keys and books, and wearable helmets and masks: pickups, quest items and props for hands.
blurbs.Armour and shields: Armour sets (all of a character's armour pieces, skinned to its skeleton, shown together as an empty suit in its reference pose), shields of every era, and helmets and masks.
